# Support

Use the [OctoPrint Community Forum][forum] for general OctoPrint installation,
configuration, printer, or connectivity questions.

For OctoPrint-Slack bugs and feature requests, search the existing issues and
then choose the appropriate issue form. Include the OctoPrint-Slack, OctoPrint,
and Python versions, clear reproduction steps, and relevant redacted logs.

Do not post Slack webhook URLs, API keys, or other secrets. Revoke and replace a
webhook immediately if it has been exposed.

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately according to
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

[forum]: https://community.octoprint.org/
